m1-parameter-order.sql:
select w.id, w.name, w.priority, w.assignee, c.name as customer_name
from work_items w
left join customers c on c.id = w.customer_id
where w.state <> 'done'
  and w.name <> $1
  and ($2 = false or ($3 = true and w.assignee is null) or ($4 = false and w.assignee = $5))
  and ($6 = false or ($7 = true and w.customer_id is null) or ($8 = false and w.customer_id = $9::bigint))
  and ($10 = false or ($11 = true and w.priority is null) or ($12 = false and w.priority = $13))
order by w.id asc
limit $14::integer offset $15::integer;

sourceRange.text: and (:assignee_supplied = false or (:assignee_is_null = true and w.assignee is null) or (:assignee_is_null = false and w.assignee = :assignee))

compiledRemovalRange.text: and ($2 = false or ($3 = true and w.assignee is null) or ($4 = false and w.assignee = $5))

sourceRange.text: and (:customer_id_supplied = false or (:customer_id_is_null = true and w.customer_id is null) or (:customer_id_is_null = false and w.customer_id = :customer_id::bigint))

compiledRemovalRange.text: and ($6 = false or ($7 = true and w.customer_id is null) or ($8 = false and w.customer_id = $9::bigint))

sourceRange.text: and (:priority_supplied = false or (:priority_is_null = true and w.priority is null) or (:priority_is_null = false and w.priority = :priority))

compiledRemovalRange.text: and ($10 = false or ($11 = true and w.priority is null) or ($12 = false and w.priority = $13))

keys.name: w.name
keys.priority: case when w.priority = 'urgent' then 1 when w.priority = 'normal' then 2 else 3 end

m5-cte-join.sql:
with visible_items as (
  select w.id, w.name, w.priority, w.assignee, w.customer_id, w.created_at
  from work_items w
  where w.state <> 'done'
    and ($1 = false or ($2 = true and w.assignee is null) or ($3 = false and w.assignee = $4))
    and ($5 = false or ($6 = true and w.customer_id is null) or ($7 = false and w.customer_id = $8::bigint))
    and ($9 = false or ($10 = true and w.priority is null) or ($11 = false and w.priority = $12))
)
select v.id, v.name, v.priority, c.name as customer_name
from visible_items v
join customers c on c.id = v.customer_id
order by v.id asc
limit $13::integer offset $14::integer;
